name: krypton-desktop-core
summary: KryptonOS Desktop Shell, Wayland Compositor, and Modern UI Utilities
description: Core desktop shell package for KryptonOS. Contains modern wallpaper assets, Wayland panel compositor, settings center, and system service integrations.

name: cmatrix
description: Simulates the digital rain effect from The Matrix movie in terminal consoles with green fluorescent cascades.

name: cowsay
summary: Configurable talking and thinking ASCII cow
description: Generates ASCII pictures of a cow saying or thinking something provided by the user.

name: neofetch
summary: Fast, highly customizable CLI system information tool
description: Neofetch displays system information alongside your operating system logo in an aesthetically pleasing terminal layout.

name: sl
summary: Steam Locomotive animator for typo prevention
description: Displays a steam locomotive driving across your terminal screen whenever you accidentally mistype ls as sl.

name: krypton-browser
summary: Quantum Sandboxed Web Browser with Live Search & YouTube Player
description: Full-featured sandboxed Web browser with DuckDuckGo Instant Search, Wikipedia API lookup, YouTube player engine, and history bookmarks.

name: krypton-taskmgr
summary: GUI System Task Manager and Performance Monitor
description: Graphical process monitor displaying live CPU load, RAM allocation, process termination controls, and thread diagnostics.

name: krypton-filemgr
summary: Graphical File Explorer and Storage Navigator
description: Desktop file manager supporting folder browsing, file previews, creation, deletion, and path navigation across the Linux VFS.

name: krypton-notes
summary: Fast lightweight text and code editor
description: Lightweight code and text editor with line numbers, syntax recognition, and direct VFS file saving.

name: krypton-calculator
description: Desktop calculator supporting arithmetic operations, percentages, square roots, and decimal calculations.
